name: Lionel Messi
biographyClues: Debuted for a Catalan giant as a teenager.
Left-footed maestro known for dribbling and playmaking.
Won a World Cup with his national team.
Holds goal and assist records in Spain.

name: Cristiano Ronaldo
biographyClues: Prolific scorer renowned for heading and athleticism.
Won league titles in England, Spain, and Italy.
All-time top scorer in UEFA club competitions.
Iconic number and celebration.

name: Zinedine Zidane
biographyClues: Elegance and first touch defined his playmaking.
Scored a famous left-foot volley in a Champions League final.
Led his nation to a World Cup title and a European championship.
Later won multiple Champions Leagues as a coach.

name: Ronaldinho
biographyClues: No-look passes and elasticos thrilled fans worldwide.
Won the Ballon d’Or in the mid-2000s.
Sparked a golden era at a Catalan club.
Iconic free-kick technique and samba flair.

name: Thierry Henry
biographyClues: Devastating pace cutting in from the left.
Integral to an unbeaten league season in England.
Transitioned from winger to prolific striker.
Later lifted a treble in Spain.
